analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI declined from 61.3 to 55.8, continuing consolidation in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram worsened from -2.7561 to -6.0540, increasing selling pressure. Despite an attempted rebound today after 5 consecutive down days, volume was insufficient. Resistance confirmed at the $608.18 20-day moving average, with the price at $605.53, 8.1% below the 52-week high.
